The complete corresponding, unmodified upstream source archive accompanies this
application as libgit2-source.tar.gz in this directory. Build integration uses
that verified archive offline. The application uses only local repository APIs;
HTTPS, SSH, NTLM and GSSAPI are disabled in this build, with system regcomp.
